title: Independent review of the AC1021 LayerStates two-root repair

review.scope: Static review of version and candidate guards, original-import publication/membership and raw/model binding, output staging and finalization rechecks, destination/refusal and retry controls, and implications for existing consumer interfaces.
review.finding: No new actionable correctness defect was identified in the reviewed bounded source profile. Existing focused physical, mutation, rollback and retry evidence is recorded in p4-ac1021-layerstates-two-root-wire-regression-repair-2026-11-18.json; the independent viewport follow-up is recorded in p4-ac1021-truetype-viewport-current-marker-selector-2026-11-18.json.
review.compatibility: For AC1021 DWG-to-DXF export at AC1021 or AC1024, a recognized two-root LayerStates source that does not satisfy the exact retained source, graph, wire, and witnessed-value profile now fails closed instead of falling through to generic output, including AllowPartial. This may reject previously attempted generic output and is a deliberate safety boundary, not a general lossless-output claim. The new code is in dwg2dxf adapter/internal source; this review does not establish LibreCAD native application compatibility.

additionalChecks.result: PASS 3/3 generated local tests; elapsed 0.26 seconds. Original terminal output was not retained as a separate log.
additionalChecks.limitations: Existing statically linked binaries were used without a clean rebuild in this review; their hashes identify the executions but do not independently bind them to current source. These are generated library-facade tests, not LibreCAD/LibreCAD_3 native builds, DWG interoperability, independent semantic witnesses, or a broad suite.

releaseNoteLocation: NEWS already has a 3.0.0 development section and is an appropriate future release-note location for the narrow fail-closed behavior. This receipt does not modify NEWS or promote a release/support claim.
